notes: Single thick frame rule on all sides. Each side's inner edge was measured column by column wherever paper lies inside the rule, smoothed with a robust local-linear fit, and the outline set ~1.5 px inside it (the first clean paper row; README rule 1), points every ~50-250 px; corners where the fitted sides meet. Where street lines run into the rule, the outline crosses them at the rule's inner edge (kind b); the rest of the little ink left under the outline is single specks by the rule. The bottom side is the top edge of the thick bar that rules off the legend/title strip (rule 3), so the strip is outside; the north arrow and scale bar sit in that strip, so there is no remove polygon. The ZONING MAP INDEX inset in the top-right corner has its own printed box rule, so it is cut out as a notch (rule 3) running ~4 px outside the box's left and bottom rules out to the frame; the blank gap between the box and the frame falls in the notch. No holes (rule 4): 'SEE SHEET 2' (vertical, left) and 'SEE SHEET 8' (bottom) are floating cross-references with no box, so they are inside. No SECTION badge on this sheet (the sheet number is in the legend strip). SAN FRANCISCO BAY and THE EMBARCADERO name places and are map.
